subject.message: The inventory owes an Android state 'permission_denied:android.permission.INTERNET', but INTERNET is a normal, install-time permission with no runtime prompt, and R10.1 and Q6 forbid any runtime permission request. The design draws the obligation honestly as the ordinary network load error ('Couldn't load your plants', Try again), with no prompt or settings link (mockups/android/no-connection.html). It does not invent a permission flow.
